ELITE: NEXT 2.5.152 - CONSISTENT MISSION CONVERSATIONS

First flight, later story, Explorers Guild, contracts, station welcome and
incoming Triangle conversations use one shared speech and reply layout.

UP/DOWN highlights a reply. CROSS chooses it. CIRCLE returns.
SELECT opens the mission log from Tracked Mission.
Long speeches show L/R and a page count: shoulder buttons turn the page.
Notifications stay above replies. Guild speaker portraits match their dialogue.

Mission actions and rewards are unchanged. No save migration is required.
Tutorial timing improvements are deferred to a later update.

Tested with the PSP emulator smoke suite and native-resolution captures.
Physical PSP playtesting remains outstanding.
